name: Three EMAs (7/12/21) simultaneous close-cross with volatility stop
author: Coinrule

instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Long when close crosses above EMA7, EMA12 and EMA21 on the same bar.
exit: Close when close > entry*1.04 (take profit 4%) or close crosses under the ATR volatility stop (length 20, factor 3).
stop_loss: Volatility stop: SMA/ATR based trailing (length 20, multiplier 3.0)
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited source; verify execution timing (signal bar vs next open) before implementation.
